---
title: "Penguin archived execution audit"
format: html
execute:
  eval: false
---

Read-only audit of archived assembly metadata. No remote writes or assembly reruns.

```{python}
import json, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
out = Path(sys.argv[1]); assert not out.exists()
remote = r'''
import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/mnt/isilon/projects/bioinformatics_platform/projects/shared_references/scratch_archives/snarayanasamy/phage_uv_treatment_20260726_full_output/output/PRJEB79569')
records=[]
for omic in ['metagenomics','metatranscriptomics']:
 for f in (root/omic/'assembly'/'.snakemake/metadata').iterdir():
  if not f.is_file():continue
  try:d=json.loads(f.read_text())
  except (ValueError,UnicodeError):continue
  if d.get('rule')=='penguin_assembly':
   records.append({'omic':omic,'path':str(f),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'metadata':d})
print(json.dumps(records))
'''
r=subprocess.run(['ssh','-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=15','iris-cluster','python3','-'],input=remote,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=90)
if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(r.stderr)
records=json.loads(r.stdout)
for omic in ['metagenomics','metatranscriptomics']:
 rows=[x for x in records if x['omic']==omic]
 assert len(rows)==12
 assert all(not x['metadata'].get('incomplete',False) and x['metadata'].get('endtime') for x in rows)
 assert all('penguin guided_nuclassemble' in x['metadata']['shellcmd'] for x in rows)
 print(omic,len(rows),'completed guided_nuclassemble records')
 print(rows[0]['metadata']['shellcmd'])
out.mkdir(parents=True)
(out/'evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2))
```
